name: Counting Quest
description: One-to-one correspondence, subitizing and quantity comparison.
author: Koda Math Lab

features.name: Tactile bounce & pop
features.description: Elastic scale animation when a countable item is touched.

features.name: Haptic vibration
features.description: Vibration pulse synchronised with the tap animation.

features.name: Spoken counter
features.description: Speaks 'one, two, three' aloud as items are touched.

features.name: 1-to-1 badges
features.description: Numbers each touched item so a child cannot double-count.

features.name: Sound chimes
features.description: Pop and success chimes during a round.
